title: (memory and order, the scene's run lists): NameObjCategoryList::execute walks a category with a NameObj** cursor and reads end() again on each pass, so that a call may add or remove (NameObjCategoryList.cpp:22-32); but add pushes onto an MR::Vector whose storage grow() moves to a new block when full (:47-51; Array.hpp:111-119, :399-402), leaving the cursor in the old block, and remove moves the last object into the removed place (:53-71), so a removal at or before the cursor skips that object for the pass. The game's own connects and disconnects are requests run between the lists' runs (SceneExecutor.cpp:38-40, :81, reaching NameObjExecuteHolder.cpp:153-196); the immediate path is MR::connectNow (NameObjExecuteHolder.cpp:312-318, :386-387), which LumaUi calls when a mod makes a layout (LumaUi.cpp:671-674), from whatever the mod was running in.
note: Found by the readall harness's Game/NameObj report (11-18, read at 0c98b11c2) and checked by reading every line cited at 241395b49. Fix: the run iterates by index against the live size, and adds and removes made during a category's run are applied at its end (or connectNow refuses inside a run and queues). Replay: identical for the disc's content (its changes go through the requests); a mod's run gains a defined order.
